statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness
The patient has a history of documented supraventricular tachycardia
The service was to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm and assess for recurrent paroxysmal tachyarrhythmias
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on missing required prior authorization
The required prior authorization was missing
